products.name: NE23 Wealth
products.subtitle: Financial Planning Platform
products.description: An institutional-grade, highly adaptive wealth management and financial planning platform engineered specifically to help advisors engage and scale their services.

features.title: Target Segment Optimization
features.description: Strategically architected for the Mass Affluent market segment

features.title: Comprehensive Client Profiling Engine
features.description: Personal Profiling (family structures, dependencies), Financial Profiling (real-time balance sheet mapping across Assets/Liabilities) to (Assets/Liabilities/Income/Expense), and Risk Profiling (algorithmic scoring).

features.title: Goal-Based Financial Architecture
features.description: Maps out precise, long-term financial strategies tied to critical life milestones (Target Retirement, Children's Higher Education, Wealth Transfer).

features.title: Advanced Scenario Simulation
features.description: Dynamic "What-If" simulation engine allowing advisors to run side-by-side comparative analyses of various market conditions and shifting timelines.

features.title: Enterprise-Grade Configurability
features.description: Built for multi-tenant operations with Multi-Level Controls, Dynamic Questionnaire Frameworks, Extensible Data Taxonomy, and strict RBAC Security.

features.title: Advisor Command Center & Reporting
features.description: Intuitive Advisor Dashboard for pipeline management alongside automated generation of client-ready, institutional-grade Financial Planning Reports.

features.title: CRM Ecosystem Interoperability
features.description: Out-of-the-box support for seamless API integrations with dominant third-party CRM systems.

products.name: NE23 Invoicing
products.subtitle: Billing System Integrator
products.description: An enterprise-grade middleware and invoicing powerhouse engineered to bridge the gap between automated billing platforms and localized regulatory compliance.

features.title: Universal Invoicing Engine
features.description: Dynamically generates compliant, beautifully formatted corporate invoices from virtually any underlying transactional system.

features.title: Native Billing Connectors
features.description: Offers seamless, out-of-the-box synchronization with leading cloud and infrastructure billing engines like HostBill and WHMCS.

features.title: Real-Time Data Ledger Sync
features.description: True bi-directional, real-time data sync that ensures the core billing system and the invoicing layer are perfectly aligned, eliminating ledger drift.

features.title: End-to-End Transaction Traceability
features.description: Implements full audit logs and immutable transaction tracing, ensuring every invoice line item can be instantly mapped back to its source event.

features.title: Regulatory & Tax Compliance Engine
features.description: Localized tax compliance automation featuring native handling of complex tax structures, regional frameworks, and Tax Deducted at Source (TDS).

features.title: E-Invoicing & Accounting Readiness
features.description: Advanced capabilities to push clean billing data directly to government e-invoicing portals and downstream corporate accounting systems.

features.title: Operations Command Center
features.description: A single-pane-of-glass Operations Dashboard giving accounting teams instant visibility into invoice health, revenue leaks, and processing exceptions.
